Switzerland / Engelberg

Kempinski Palace Engelberg

A Kempinski hotel in Engelberg, the monastery village below the Titlis. Set up for ski days: a contact of the ski school in the lobby, a locker in the ski cellar for every room, and boots dried for the next morning.

Plan a stay hereAbout Engelberg

In short

What to know.

  • A contact of the ski school in the hotel lobby; private ski and snowboard instructors arranged in the hotel
  • Every room has its own locker in the ski cellar, and boots are dried for the next day
  • A concierge team for information and reservations
  • Sister hotel: Frutt Mountain Resort, to extend the stay

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For skiers who want an easy trip from Zurich or Lucerne and a hotel that takes care of the ski day.

Good to know.

The hotel stay is provided by Kempinski Palace Engelberg. EverFlow arranges your stay; your contract is with the hotel.

For hotel and chalet stays we arrange, we may receive a commission from the provider.
